name: Crimson Spark
description: Throw a deep red spark that burns hotter than the common kind and clings to what it hits.

name: Ruddy Ember
description: Light matching red embers in both palms to raise the heat of the next two moves.

name: Scarlet Veil
description: Hold a scarlet veil of flame before the body that hardens against heavy blows.

name: Ember Fork
description: Strike with two fingers wrapped in fire to burn two points at once.

name: Dual Crimson Lash
description: Whip a red lash of fire from each hand so the two cross over the target's guard.

name: Pyre Echo
description: Strike with one burning hand and let a second burn rise from the same spot a breath later.

name: Matched Burn
description: Land two even burns on both sides of the guard so that it opens under the pressure of both.

name: Vermilion Surge
description: Gather qi into a red tide of fire and release it across the ground ahead as a rolling sheet of heat.

name: Crossed Pyre Rend
description: Cross two burning hands to tear a hole in a guard of qi and burn what lies behind it.

name: Paired Conflagration
description: Light two great fires at once and bring them together over the target so the burst fills a wide space and breaks guards.

name: Hawk Cinder
description: Fling a cinder trailing a red tail that falls on the target from the high line.

name: Pinion Glow
description: Spread a bright wing of fire round the shoulder to turn glancing strikes.

name: Aerial Warmth
description: Read the heat of bodies below from above through the rising air.

name: Raptor Flare
description: Burn the target with a clawed strike lit by a sudden flare of fire.

name: Updraft Spark
description: Ride a spark of rising heat up a short step to gain height.

name: Diving Cinder
description: Fall on a rising draft of heat and strike with a fiery shoulder and fist.

name: Burning Vane
description: Beat a fire wing across the line of attack to bat a spear or an arrow away.

name: Heat Plume
description: Spread a burning plume wide from above to scorch those caught beneath it.

name: Furnace Fall
description: Rise high on a column of heat and drop a great sphere of fire that bursts over the ground below.

name: Talon Brand
description: Stoop onto the target and press a branding talon of fire into the shoulder so the arm cannot rise.

name: Scorching Stoop
description: Plunge from a great height wrapped in a hawk of flame and hit with enough heat to burn through plate and qi alike.

name: Flowing Ember
description: Pour a stream of ember sparks along a curve that follows the target's path.

name: Current Glow
description: Let a thin current of heat run along the ground and read what it passes.

name: Rivulet Burn
description: Draw a thin stream of fire along the target's arm so that it runs into the seams.

name: Flame Tributary
description: Branch one stream of fire into several that spread over the ground and burn the feet.

name: Burning Channel
description: Lay a channel of fire across the footing that forces an opponent into a fixed line.

name: Undercurrent Heat
description: Run heat beneath the skin to push back a strike and carry its force away along the limb.

name: Cascading Blaze
description: Pour a great fall of fire from the hands that spreads and burns everything it crosses.

name: Cinder Flood
description: Release a flood of glowing cinders that fills the ground to knee height and burns anything within.

name: Torrential Inferno
description: Open the hands and loose a river of fire that carries all before it and does not stop at the first guard.

name: Yoked Ember
description: Tie two embers together in the chest so the heat of one feeds the other.

name: Duet Bolt
description: Throw two bolts with a half-breath between them so the second lands on the opening of the first.

name: Linked Veil
description: Link two flame veils edge to edge so the pair covers the body and the arms.

name: Dual Warmth
description: Pass warmth through two points on an ally's body to ease a deep ache and slow the bleeding.

name: Pairing Flare
description: Flare both hands at different times to leave the eye unsure which hand holds the real strike.

name: Yoked Pyre
description: Raise two pyres joined by a line of fire beneath the target so the ground between them burns.

name: Duet Lash
description: Lash twice with fire in a crossing rhythm that the guard cannot follow.

name: Joint Surge
description: Time strike and guard together so that each burning hand does the work of both.

name: Pairing Cinder
description: Drive two needles of fire into the same joint from two sides.

name: Twofold Conflagration
description: Build two great fires and release them in turn so the second catches those who fled the first.

name: Dual Sear Rend
description: Cross both arms in fire and cut apart a guard of qi with the crossed edge of heat.

name: Twin Blaze Reckoning
description: Close two flames from either side and burst them together at the center so the whole space is burned at once.

name: Parallel Spark
description: Fire two sparks along two straight paths that never cross but reach the same body.

name: Track Warmth
description: Run warmth along the two tracks of an ally's body to ease a strain in both.

name: Split Kindle
description: Split the held flame into two streams that feed the left and right arms.

name: Fold Veil
description: Fold one veil of flame over another so the second still holds when the first breaks.

name: Bifold Lash
description: Run fire down both arms into two lashes that reach the target from opposite sides.

name: Burn Relay
description: Hand the burn from one track to the other mid-strike so it does not weaken between blows.

name: Counter Flame
description: Catch a flame on one track and send it back to the caster along the other.

name: Dual Pyre Run
description: Run along two lines of fire at once and leave a burning lane behind.

name: Mirrored Inferno
description: Light a great fire on one side and its mirror on the other so the middle is crushed in heat.

name: Parallel Inferno
description: Drive two vast fires down two tracks across a field at once so nothing between them stands untouched.

name: Sealed Coal
description: Seal a coal of heat in the dantian to be released at the next strike.

name: Kept Flame
description: Keep a pale flame close to the heart that guards against the first strike of any kind.

name: Hidden Spark
description: Slip a fleck of sealed fire into the target's guard and let it flare from within.

name: Latent Burn
description: Touch the target and leave a sealed burn that wakes a breath later.

name: Locked Blaze
description: Lock a target's qi point with a seal of fire that holds one flow of qi for some breaths.

name: Dormant Surge
description: Hold a sealed store of heat for long hours to be called up at the instant it is needed.

name: Unsealed Fire
description: Break the seal in the dantian and let all the stored heat out at once over a wide space.

name: Governed Inferno
description: Release the sealed fire a little at a time against one target so that it cannot be fully escaped.

name: Awakened Brand
description: Break the seal on a branding fire at contact so the stored heat sinks into the target and burns the qi from within.

name: Sworn Cinder
description: Throw a cinder bound by a short vow so that it will not go out before it lands.

name: Breathborne Ember
description: Carry a lit ember on a long breath out to the target and let it settle on cloth.

name: Draft Glow
description: Read the shape of the draft in the bend of a small flame and know where the air will turn.

name: Bound Blaze
description: Hold a vowed flame at the chest which is bound not to fail under the first blow.

name: Windfed Veil
description: Let the wind feed a veil of flame so that it grows brighter the harder the gust blows.

name: Breathfed Pyre
description: Feed a pyre with the wind and the breath so that it roars and spreads along the ground.

name: Vowed Needle
description: Speak the vow and send a single hard needle of fire that cannot be turned from its mark.

name: Draught Sear
description: Ride a hot draught past the guard and sear the unguarded side.

name: Anchored Inferno
description: Stand sworn to the spot while a vast fire rises round the user and burns whatever draws near.

name: Sworn Firestorm
description: Speak the oath of the pyre and loose a storm of fire driven by the wind across the whole front.

name: Wind-Sworn Conflagration
description: Take the vow of wind and flame together and let a fire sweep the whole bearing so wide it cannot be outrun.

name: Heading Ember
description: Hold an ember on a fixed heading and loose it straight at the mark.

name: Course Glow
description: Hold a glow to a line and read heat along it to find the straight way through smoke.

name: Steady Torch
description: Keep a torch of qi at arm's length that burns whatever crosses its line.

name: Arm Flare
description: Strike along a drawn line with a flare that follows the arm to the target.

name: Fixed Burn
description: Hold the heading and keep burning one spot without a waver until the guard goes.

name: Bearing Torrent
description: Loose a narrow torrent of fire straight along the line of sight.

name: Unturning Flame
description: Face the blow and let a strong flame hold unturned before the body.

name: Sighted Pyre
description: Take sight of a far target and raise a pyre beneath it from the user's own hand.

name: Bearing Rupture
description: Drive a hard narrow ray along the bearing that breaks through shield after shield.

name: Unerring Blaze
description: Fix the heading beyond the guard and loose one blaze that cannot be turned from its line and burns through whatever stands on it.

name: Naked Flame
description: Throw a flame with no shield on the thrower and trust the speed of the throw.

name: Open Ember
description: Let the ember burn outside the body where all can see and feel the heat rise.

name: Bare Glow
description: Burn a bare glow round the body to feel anyone drawing close across the open ground.

name: Uncovered Spark
description: Fire sparks straight from the open hand at several marks with no guard held back.

name: Wideopen Warmth
description: Stand open before an ally and let warmth pour through the whole body to ease a wound.

name: Exposed Pyre
description: Light a pyre in the open and let its heat spread outward with nothing to hold it back.

name: Unscreened Burn
description: Strike openly with no screen of qi and let the sheer heat drive through the guard.

name: Breathing Fire
description: Breathe fire across a wide front in the open without turning away from the answer.

name: Unhidden Dash
description: Run straight across open ground on a trail of fire that hides nothing.

name: Boundless Blaze
description: Open the arms and let a fire grow outward as far as the qi will carry it.

name: Clear Flame
description: Hold a clear open flame over a poisoned ally and draw the poison out through the skin.

name: Unwalled Inferno
description: Throw back every guard and release the full fire in the open so that nothing can hide from it.

name: Giving Palm
description: Offer a warm open palm to an ally and let healing heat pass into the wound.

name: Flat Hand Burn
description: Strike with the flat of a burning hand to push and scorch in one motion.

name: Palm Glow
description: Catch a blow on the open palm and bend it aside in a flare.

name: Receiving Flame
description: Take a fire attack on the open palm and return its heat to the sender.

name: Spreading Palm
description: Spread the open hands to throw a wide fan of fire that scorches the near ground.

name: Offering Heat
description: Lay an open hand on an ally's back and send steady heat into the limbs to raise strength.

name: Tending Fire
description: Hold both open palms over an ally's deep wound and knit the flesh with gentle heat.

name: Radiant Palm
description: Open the hand at the last instant and release all the stored light as a searing blast.

name: Consuming Palm
description: Press the open hand to the target and let fire pour out of it until the guard burns to nothing.

name: Far Ember
description: Send a hard ember a very long way without losing its heat.

name: Ember Reach
description: Extend a glow far ahead and read the warmth of whatever stands in it.

name: Reaching Flame
description: Lengthen the reach of a strike with a tongue of fire that stretches past the fingertips.

name: Trace Fire
description: Lay a faint line of fire on the ground that a pursuer cannot cross at a run.

name: Extended Lash
description: Stretch a lash of fire across a great distance and snap it onto the target.

name: Distant Pyre
description: Raise a pyre far across open ground beneath a target the user can see but not touch.

name: Hanging Flare
description: Hang a bright flare high in the air to pull every eye to one point.

name: Searing Beam
description: Narrow fire to a hot beam that pierces a long way and burns through whatever stands in its path.

name: Distant Torrent
description: Gather qi and pour a torrent of fire across a great span of open ground.

name: Unending Reach
description: Take a bearing on a target far beyond sight and send one fire along it that burns undimmed to the end.

name: Oath Cinder
description: Throw a cinder bound by oath so that it burns until it reaches the mark.

name: Vow Kindle
description: Speak the vow aloud and light a flame in the chest that steadies the body.

name: Vowed Warmth
description: Swear to the ally and pass warmth into the wound until the bleeding is held.

name: Binding Flame
description: Tie a thread of vowed fire between two people so that neither strays far.

name: Flame Ward
description: Swear to guard and hold a bright ward of fire before the one the oath names.

name: Oath Brand
description: Burn the sign of a vow onto the target's chest so they cannot turn the flame against the sworn.

name: Swelling Vow
description: Let a growing vow raise heat in the whole body of the user and the allies who share it.

name: Vowed Palm
description: Strike once with the whole vow behind the fire so that no guard can deny the blow.

name: Burning Pledge
description: Stake the user's own heat on the stroke and burn through any guard for as long as the pledge holds.

name: Fire Pact
description: Bind the qi of nearby allies to the user's flame so that all share its warmth and its guard.

name: Pledged Inferno
description: Set the user's life-heat behind the vow and release a vast fire that burns only those the oath names.
